Directly creating folders within the app is not currently supported.

For IMAP accounts, you can create new folders from your providers webmail. These will then display in the app the next time you refresh the apps folder list.

To refresh the list,

  1. Open the side bar with your account folders visible
  2. Tap manage folders at the bottom of the list
  3. Tap the three dot ፧ menu > refresh folder list

Contacts should be added to your default contacts app such as google contacts.

  1. Grant TB permission to read your contacts.
  2. Add a name and email address using your contacts app.

To select a contact in TB,

  1. open the message compose or reply screen
  2. Tap the three dot ፧ menu > add from contacts.

Note the "add from contacts" option is not displayed until permissions are granted

A github pull request was raised but closed in June this year to add proxy support. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/pull/11155

Developers provided the below comment on the ticket.

We are prioritizing PRs that align with our roadmap, and at this time this feature isn't in the areas that we are targeted. We will revisit this if adding Mail Proxy Support becomes a higher priority.

Mozilla connect is the best place to raise feature requests, where community members can vote on them. The TB team take these into consideration when reviewing roadmaps and priorities.

You can see the current roadmap here.
